status: D-044 through D-048 are implemented; D-047 is implemented procedurally by D-059

decisions.D-044: Mineral is the only resource. The former additional resource categories and their discovery state are removed.
decisions.D-045: Residents sink into valid surface homes, hide after nearby noise, return after brief noise, and relocate to the nearest free valid home after sustained noise.
decisions.D-046: Before a terrain edit reaches a sunk resident, push it onto the resulting surface. Added terrain above a hidden resident makes it rise to the new surface. A valid home requires enough soil depth.
decisions.D-047: Author one native species per planet across nine planets. The first playable authored slice is Ares-9 with the Facet Pebble.
decisions.D-059: Each signal planet gets the species whose native planet best matches its size, relief and minerals; planets found by one signal never share a species. Each species has its own temperament in tuning.residents.temperament.
decisions.D-048: Keep the mineral seed namespace exactly `${seed}:resource:mineral` and preserve the generator's random-call order so existing mineral positions do not move.

visualDirection.principle: Keep terrain restrained and give resident silhouettes the stronger color identity.
visualDirection.note: The runtime palette is intentionally not duplicated here so design and code cannot drift.

implementationBoundary: Home and Resident live in the run store. Ares-9 gets 3-5 deterministic residents. Surface-home validation, sinking behavior, bounded searching and terrain-edit displacement are implemented.
